title: Delete a SonicForge voice
description:
Delete a character voice. The reference takes saved for design and clone go with it, so no new line can be made in that voice afterwards; audio already generated is unaffected.

Recreating the same voice gives a different person — voice design has no reproducibility. Delete only when you are sure it is finished with. To change delivery, keep the voice and choose sonic.generate's input.emotion instead.
